title: Grade 9 Biology National Exam & Practice 2018 (4 Chapters Combined)
description: Comprehensive examination bank combining 4 chapters (13 questions). Official Ethiopian national curriculum.

questions.questionText: If you are asked to write the taxonomic hierarchy of modern human being from the kingdom downwards, what will be the correct sequence the taxon?
options: Animalia → Hominidae → Mammalia → Primata → Homo → Chordata → Homo sapiens
Animalia → Mammalia → Chordata → Hominidae → Primata → Homo → Homo sapiens
Animalia → Chordata → Mammalia → Primata → Hominidae → Homo → Homo sapiens
Animalia → Primata → Mammalia → Chordata → Hominidae → Homo → Homo sapiens
questions.explanation: The taxonomic hierarchy of humans from Kingdom down is: Kingdom (Animalia) → Phylum (Chordata) → Class (Mammalia) → Order (Primata) → Family (Hominidae) → Genus (Homo) → Species (Homo sapiens).

questions.questionText: Which one of the following statements correctly presents the importance of biological classification? It
options: allows biologists to study the relationship between organisms.
avoids confusion by giving names based on local languages.
is an ancient science with limited practical relevance today.
increases energy and time to study the evolution of organisms.
questions.explanation: Biological classification helps scientists systematically group organisms based on evolutionary relationships and shared characteristics.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is INCORRECT about an organism classified under the kingdom Protista? It is
questions.explanation: Archaea and bacteria belong to Prokaryotic domains (Archaea and Eubacteria), whereas organisms in the Kingdom Protista are eukaryotic.

questions.questionText: The transport of gases and water through the cell membrane based on concentration gradient is possible because of
questions.explanation: Gas transport across cell membranes occurs via simple diffusion, and water transport primarily occurs via osmosis down their concentration gradients.

questions.questionText: All of the following are organelles located in the cytoplasm of a eukaryotic cell EXCEPT
questions.explanation: The plasma membrane is the outer boundary surrounding the cell that encloses the cytoplasm, rather than an organelle located within the cytoplasm.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following subcellular structures is found in both animal and plant cells?
questions.explanation: Ribosomes are essential sites of protein synthesis present in both animal and plant cells. Cell walls, chloroplasts, and plastids are present in plant cells but absent in animal cells.

questions.questionText: An organism having the following characteristics can be grouped under animals.
options: Prokaryotic cell, cell wall and respiration
Autotroph, movement and response to stimuli
questions.explanation: Animals are eukaryotic, multicellular, heterotrophic organisms (many of which breathe/respire). They lack cell walls, prokaryotic structures, or autotrophic capabilities.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following nutrients is correctly matched with its primary role to the human body?
questions.explanation: Lipids (fats) serve as long-term energy storage and thermal insulation to maintain body heat reserve.

questions.questionText: The general term used when an elementary school child get sick because of shortage of enough amount of one particular nutrient is
questions.explanation: A deficiency disease is an illness caused by a lack of essential dietary nutrients such as specific vitamins or minerals.

questions.questionText: A sick person who lost his appetite has lost much of his body weight. Which of the following more accurately explains this condition?
options: Since there is no food intake, his body muscle starts to respire anaerobically.
Due to shortage of nutrients, the body is utilizing its fat or protein reserves.
The person could unable to do heavy physical exercises to strengthen his muscles.
The person's body is expending its nutrients for immune responses to defend itself.
questions.explanation: During periods of severe appetite loss or starvation, the body mobilizes its fat stores and breaks down muscle proteins to generate energy, leading to weight loss.

questions.questionText: When an individual underwent medical checkup, his overall condition is judged normal except that he is extremely cold-sensitive and has abnormally a dry skin. To which of the following macromolecules the problem most likely related while keeping all other factors normal?
questions.explanation: Lipids provide subcutaneous insulation against cold and help maintain skin moisture and barrier function; a severe deficiency or impairment can cause cold sensitivity and dry skin.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following ecological levels includes all the rest?
questions.explanation: The biosphere encompasses all biomes, ecosystems, communities, and populations on Earth, representing the highest level of ecological organization.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is correct about the conservation mechanism of wild life?
options: Indigenous practices relay on the use of taboos for conservation of plants.
Modern practices relay on growing invasive plants in mountainous area in order to prevent soil erosion.
Controlled wildlife hunting areas can't be considered one of the conservation mechanisms.
Wild life conservation is selective protection of a species with economic significances and eliminating less valued species.
questions.explanation: Indigenous conservation strategies traditionally rely on social norms, sacred groves, and cultural taboos to restrict the exploitation of specific plant and animal species.
